reports.title: Federal Law No. 282-FZ of 29 November 2007 “On Official Statistical Accounting and the System of State Statistics in the Russian Federation”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation / State Duma
reports.description: Foundational federal law establishing the legal basis for official statistical accounting and the system of state statistics in the Russian Federation. Defines subjects of official statistical accounting (including Rosstat and the Bank of Russia), the obligation to apply official statistical methodology, the Federal Plan for Statistical Works, confidentiality of primary data, and the production and dissemination of official statistical information. Multiple subsequent amendments (latest relevant revisions through 2024–2025). All Rosstat series and methodologies cite this law as the primary legal foundation.

reports.title: Government Decree No. 420 of 2 June 2008 “On the Federal State Statistics Service” (Statute on Rosstat)
reports.publisher: Government of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Statute defining the status, functions and powers of the Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat) as the federal executive body responsible for forming official statistical information on social, economic, demographic, environmental and other processes in the Russian Federation. Implements and operationalises Federal Law 282-FZ. Subsequent amendments maintain its force.

reports.title: National Accounts of the Russian Federation — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: System of national accounts compiled by Rosstat in accordance with SNA 2008. Includes GDP at current and constant prices by production, expenditure and income approaches, value-added by sector, and related accounts and tables. Methodology and dissemination are governed by Federal Law 282-FZ and the Statute on Rosstat. Russian national-accounts data are a core input to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication national-accounts chapter.

reports.title: Population Statistics — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official population statistics of the Russian Federation produced by Rosstat, including current population estimates, vital statistics and related demographic indicators. Disseminated under the framework of Federal Law 282-FZ and the Federal Plan for Statistical Works. Population data are regularly contributed to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports.title: Employment and Unemployment Statistics — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official labour-market statistics covering employment, unemployment, wages and related indicators. Produced by Rosstat under the legal framework of Federal Law 282-FZ. Labour-force and employment data appear in the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication and in Rosstat SDDS metadata.

reports.title: Federal Plan for Statistical Works (approved by Government Order No. 671-r of 6 May 2008, as amended)
reports.publisher: Government of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Government-approved plan that schedules the production and dissemination of official statistical information by all subjects of official statistical accounting (Rosstat, Bank of Russia and others). Specific items (e.g., 1.29.3 for CPI) determine publication frequency and timeliness. The Plan is the operational instrument that implements Federal Law 282-FZ for the annual and monthly statistical work programme.

reports.title: Bank of Russia Annual Report
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Annual report of the Bank of Russia prepared pursuant to Federal Law No. 86-FZ of 10 July 2002 “On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)”. Contains analysis of the economic situation, monetary policy, financial market, balance of payments, international reserves, payment systems, and the Bank’s own financial statements. Recent editions (including 2024) reference BRICS payment-cooperation work and the BRICS Cross-Border Payments Initiative.

reports.title: Balance of Payments, International Investment Position and External Debt of the Russian Federation — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Official statistics on the balance of payments, international investment position and external debt compiled and disseminated by the Bank of Russia. Form part of the external-sector statistical framework used in CRA-related analysis and appear in the Bank of Russia Annual Report and related publications. Relevant to Russia’s commitments and analytical support under the BRICS Contingent Reserve Arrangement.

reports.title: International Reserves of the Russian Federation — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Weekly and monthly data on the international (gold and foreign-exchange) reserves of the Russian Federation published by the Bank of Russia. Constitute a core external-sector indicator relevant to liquidity and CRA-related analysis. Disseminated on the Bank of Russia website and summarised in the Annual Report.

reports.title: Russia: Statistical Pocketbook (annual)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Annual statistical pocketbook published by Rosstat providing concise official data and infographics on the socio-economic situation of the Russian Federation (demography, labour market, living standards, prices, trade, finance, foreign economic activity, etc.). Serves as a widely disseminated summary of core Rosstat series.

reports.title: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast Statistical Yearbook (Статистический ежегодник «Нижегородская область»)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Nizhegorodstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Volga Federal District). Multi-year data on population, labour, living standards, industry, construction, trade, investment and social sphere. Electronic editions (PDF/RAR) published regularly; latest cover windows up to 2025.

reports.title: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast in Figures (Нижегородская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Nizhegorodstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook with a compact presentation of key socio-economic indicators.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Nizhegorodstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational report on the socio-economic situation of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. High-frequency counterpart to the annual yearbook series.

reports.title: Samara Statistical Yearbook (Самарский статистический ежегодник)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Samara Oblast (Samarastat)
reports.description: Principal annual statistical publication for Samara Oblast (Volga Federal District, major industrial and automotive centre). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry, trade, investment and social indicators. Long electronic series available.

reports.title: Samara Oblast in Figures (Самарская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Samara Oblast (Samarastat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Samara Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Samara Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Samara Oblast (Samarastat)
reports.description: Recurring (monthly) report on the socio-economic situation of Samara Oblast. High-frequency layer feeding the annual yearbook.

reports.title: Statistical Yearbook of Chelyabinsk Oblast (Статистический ежегодник по Челябинской области)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Chelyabinsk Oblast (Chelyabinskstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication for Chelyabinsk Oblast (Urals Federal District, major industrial and metallurgical centre). Multi-year data on population, labour, industry, construction, trade and social sphere. Electronic editions published regularly; appendix of socio-economic indicators also issued.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Chelyabinsk Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Chelyabinsk Oblast (Chelyabinskstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational publications and monthly reports on the socio-economic situation of Chelyabinsk Oblast. High-frequency counterpart to the annual yearbook.

reports.title: Irkutsk Oblast Statistical Yearbook (Статистический ежегодник. Иркутская область)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Irkutsk Oblast (Irkutskstat)
reports.description: Full annual statistical yearbook for Irkutsk Oblast (Siberian Federal District). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry (including resource and energy profile), construction, trade and social indicators. Provides additional Siberian industrial coverage alongside Krasnoyarsk and Novosibirsk.

reports.title: Irkutsk Oblast in Figures (Иркутская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Irkutsk Oblast (Irkutskstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Irkutsk Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Irkutsk Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Irkutsk Oblast (Irkutskstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational report on the socio-economic situation of Irkutsk Oblast. High-frequency layer feeding the annual yearbook series.

reports.title: Industrial Production in Russia (Промышленное производство в России)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical collection characterising mining, manufacturing, electricity, gas and water supply. Covers production volumes, indices, financial results, employment and other indicators by type of economic activity. From 2014 published electronically; subject-level data for all federal subjects are issued as a separate electronic appendix. Continues the earlier series «Industry of Russia». Principal national sectoral source for industrial statistics with full regional breakdown.

reports.title: Industrial Production in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Electronic appendix to the collection «Industrial Production in Russia» containing detailed indicators in the breakdown of federal subjects. Enables direct comparison of industrial structure and performance across the subjects already covered in the regional layer (Sverdlovsk, Chelyabinsk, Krasnoyarsk, Tatarstan, etc.).

reports.title: Main Indicators of Agriculture in Russia (Основные показатели сельского хозяйства в России)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Statistical bulletin presenting the principal indicators of Russian agriculture: sown areas, livestock, crop and livestock production, structure of output by category of farm, financial results, prices, investment and capacities. Selected indicators are given by federal district and by subject of the Federation. Core national agricultural statistical product with regional dimension.

reports.title: Agriculture in Russia (Сельское хозяйство в России) — Statistical Collection
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Fuller statistical collection on agriculture in the Russian Federation, covering production, structure by farm type, resources, financial performance and related indicators. Complements the more frequent main-indicators bulletin and supplies the national agricultural frame used by subject-level agricultural tables in regional yearbooks (especially relevant for Krasnodar, Rostov, Bashkortostan, etc.).

reports.title: Construction in Russia (Строительство в России)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical collection on the construction complex: volume of work under the activity «Construction», financial indicators of construction organisations, employment and wages, investment in fixed capital, commissioning of fixed assets, residential and social-facility construction, business activity surveys. Subject-level information is published as a separate electronic appendix. Primary national source for construction and housing statistics with full regional coverage.

reports.title: Construction in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Electronic appendix to «Construction in Russia» containing detailed construction, investment and housing indicators broken down by federal subject. Directly links national construction statistics to the subject yearbooks already in the graph.

reports.title: Transport in Russia (Транспорт в России)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Statistical collection on the state of transport in the Russian Federation: railway, road, water, air, pipeline and other modes; length of networks; rolling stock; freight and passenger traffic; financial and labour indicators; accidents. Subject-level data are issued as a separate electronic appendix. National sectoral transport frame used by regional transport tables.

reports.title: Transport in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Electronic appendix to «Transport in Russia» providing transport indicators by federal subject. Supports cross-subject comparison of transport infrastructure and activity.

reports.title: Main Indicators of Environmental Protection (Основные показатели охраны окружающей среды)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Statistical bulletin presenting the principal indicators of the impact of economic activity on the natural environment in the Russian Federation: atmospheric emissions (stationary and mobile), water abstraction and losses, waste generation and treatment, and related measures. Multi-year series; forms the core environmental statistical product of Rosstat.

reports.title: Environmental Protection in Russia (Охрана окружающей среды в России)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Full statistical collection on the state of the environment and the use and protection of natural resources. Covers atmospheric air, water, land, forest and hunting resources, waste management, specially protected natural areas, and expenditure on environmental protection. Published biennially in electronic form. National environmental frame that underpins regional environmental tables in subject yearbooks.

reports.title: Commissioning of Residential Buildings and Housing Statistics (series)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Recurring official statistical series and analytical notes on the commissioning of residential buildings (by region, by form of ownership, by material of walls, storey height, etc.), average construction cost per square metre, and related housing indicators. Closely linked to the Construction in Russia collection and to subject-level housing tables.

reports.title: Healthcare in Russia (Здравоохранение в России)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Principal official statistical collection on the state of healthcare in the Russian Federation. Covers med-demographic indicators of population health, organisation and accessibility of medical and spa-resort care, labour market and staffing in healthcare, production of medical goods, and related indicators. Prepared from federal statistical observation of legal entities and the population, sample surveys, and data from the Ministry of Health and other agencies. Published annually in electronic form (series since 2001). Subject-level data for 2015 onward are issued as a separate electronic appendix, enabling systematic inter-regional comparison.

reports.title: Healthcare in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Electronic appendix to «Healthcare in Russia» containing detailed healthcare, morbidity, staffing and medical-organisation indicators broken down by federal subject for multi-year periods (e.g. 2015–2024). Primary vehicle for regional health statistics under the national methodological framework.

reports.title: Medical Organisations, Hospital Beds and Medical Staff — Official Series
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Recurring official statistical series on the number of medical organisations (hospital and outpatient), hospital beds by specialisation, and medical personnel (physicians of all specialties, mid-level staff). Published for the Russian Federation and used as input to the Healthcare in Russia collection and regional yearbooks. Reflects both state and non-state (including private) provision.

reports.title: Population Morbidity by Main Classes of Diseases and Socially Significant Diseases — Official Series
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical series on morbidity of the population by main classes of diseases and by socially significant diseases. Forms a core med-demographic component of the Healthcare in Russia collection and is published with regional detail in the subject appendix and in regional socio-economic yearbooks.

reports.title: Production of Medicines and Medical Materials (Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Statistics)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official industrial statistics on the production of medicinal products and materials used for medical and veterinary purposes (ОКВЭД pharmaceutical manufacturing). Released as part of monthly/annual industrial production indices and volume indicators. Recent figures show strong growth (e.g. +15.4% in 2025). There is no separate standalone Rosstat «Pharmaceutical Industry of Russia» yearbook of the same type as Industry or Construction; pharmaceutical production is embedded in the Industrial Production in Russia system and its subject appendix. Market structure and retail pharmacy data are largely compiled by private research firms and are outside the official statistical graph.

reports.title: Ministry of Health of the Russian Federation — Policy and Administrative Data Supplier
reports.publisher: Ministry of Health of the Russian Federation (Minzdrav Russia)
reports.description: Federal executive body responsible for state policy and legal regulation in healthcare. Supplies administrative and sectoral data that Rosstat incorporates into official healthcare statistics (alongside direct statistical observation). Methodological control of official statistical indicators remains with Rosstat under the Federal Law on official statistical accounting; Minzdrav is the primary policy and data-provider partner rather than an independent statistical publisher of the same standing as Rosstat collections.

reports.title: Education Statistics — Official Series (Preschool, General, Vocational, Higher)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical series and tables on education in the Russian Federation covering preschool education, general education, secondary vocational education, higher education, postgraduate training and related indicators. Data are published for the Federation and by subject; detailed forms are also maintained by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Science and Higher Education. Fills a previously thin education node in the graph.

reports.title: Tourism Statistics — Official Series (Trips, Collective Accommodation, Tourist Firms)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical information on tourism: number of tourist trips (domestic and outbound/inbound), collective means of accommodation (hotels, sanatoria, etc.) by region, tourist firms, and related indicators. Strong regional differentiation (Krasnodar Krai, Crimea, Moscow rank high in accommodation stock). Complements the sectoral layer and links to regional yearbooks of tourism-intensive subjects.

reports.title: Labour Force Survey / Employment and Unemployment Statistics
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Core recurring labour-market statistical product based on sample surveys of the population (aligned with ILO methodology). Provides employment, unemployment, labour-force participation and related indicators for the Federation and subjects. Underpins labour sections of regional yearbooks and the Healthcare labour-market tables; previously under-represented as a distinct node relative to its systemic importance.

_variants.description: Sample labour force survey conducted monthly in all regions of Russia (with noted geographic exceptions). Planned monthly sample of approximately 77,000 persons aged 15 and over. Methodology complies with ILO standards. Source of official employment, unemployment and related labour-market indicators. Data feed the employment and unemployment series published under SDDS and the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports._variants_reviewed: 2026-08-18: Adopted the variant region. The kept record said "Europe", which is wrong for a Russian national labour force survey. Kept the series-page URL over the variant PDF.

reports.title: Consumer Price Indices and Price Statistics (detailed series)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official consumer price index (CPI) and detailed price statistics for goods and services, including regional CPI series. High-frequency product that feeds living-standards and inflation analysis in every subject yearbook and in national accounts. Strengthens the price/living-standards dimension that was thinner than production-side sectoral coverage.

reports.title: Research and Development (R&D) Statistics — Official Series
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical series on organisations performing research and development, R&D personnel, intramural expenditure on R&D, and related indicators. Data are collected under federal statistical observation and form the primary official input used by both Rosstat tables and the partnership publications of HSE ISSEK / Ministry of Science and Higher Education. Provides the national R&D statistical frame; regional detail appears in subject yearbooks and in the science/innovation data books that draw on Rosstat.

reports.title: Science. Technology. Innovation / Science Indicators (HSE ISSEK data books)
reports.publisher: HSE Institute for Statistical Studies and Economics of Knowledge (in partnership with Rosstat and Ministry of Science and Higher Education)
reports.description: Annual statistical data books in the series «Наука. Технологии. Инновации» and «Индикаторы науки». Compile and present Rosstat R&D and innovation statistics together with data from Minobrnauki, Rospatent and international sources. High-quality, widely cited analytical-statistical products; included because they are co-produced with Rosstat and systematically structure the official R&D data for users. Not a pure Rosstat collection, but the principal published form in which Russian science and innovation statistics are disseminated.

reports.title: State of Crime in the Russian Federation (Состояние преступности) — Official Series
reports.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation (MVD) / Main Information and Analytical Centre
reports.description: Authoritative official statistical series on registered crime in the Russian Federation, published monthly and annually by MVD. Covers total registered crimes, structure by type (against the person, property, economic, etc.), use of ICT, regional breakdowns, and clearance indicators. Rosstat may republish selected crime-related social indicators, but the primary official source and methodological owner is MVD. Regional detail is systematic (growth/decline reported by number of subjects).

reports.title: Culture Sector Statistics — Ministry of Culture Statistical System
reports.publisher: Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation (Minkultury)
reports.description: Official sectoral statistical reporting system for culture (AIS «Statistika» and related forms). Covers cultural institutions (federal, regional, municipal), staffing, wages, and activity indicators. Rosstat publishes selected culture-related social indicators; the detailed institutional and activity statistics are maintained by the Ministry of Culture and its territorial network. Complements the social-statistics side of the graph.

reports.title: Balance of Production and Consumption of Electricity (by Russian Federation and Subjects)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical methodology and published balance of production and consumption of electricity for the Russian Federation, federal districts, subjects of the Federation, and selected zones (including the Arctic zone). Approved by Rosstat Order (e.g. Order 353 of 2025). Strengthens the energy statistical layer beyond the earlier fuel-energy methodology notes and links directly to industrial production and regional yearbooks of energy-intensive subjects.

reports.title: Fuel-Energy Balances of Subjects of the Russian Federation and Municipal Formations — Order and Framework
reports.publisher: Ministry of Energy of the Russian Federation (Minenergo) (methodology); data compilation involves Rosstat and territorial organs
reports.description: Official procedure for compiling fuel-energy balances of subjects of the Russian Federation and municipal formations (Minenergo Order 1169/2021, as amended). Defines composition, information sources and stages of balance construction. Provides the regulatory and methodological frame for subject-level energy balances; actual published balances appear in regional and national energy statistical products. Complements the Rosstat electricity-balance series.

reports.title: Social Sphere Indicators (extended series covering education, health, culture, crime-related social measures)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Extended set of official social-statistics series that appear across the Russian Statistical Yearbook, Regions of Russia, and specialised collections. Includes indicators that bridge education, healthcare, culture and selected crime-related social measures. Serves as a residual high-level node that ties the specialised social collections together under the national social-statistics framework.

reports.title: Russian Statistical Yearbook (Российский статистический ежегодник)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Flagship annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of the Russian Federation. Aggregates and presents the main results of the entire official statistical system across all domains (national accounts, industry, agriculture, construction, transport, trade, prices, labour, living standards, population, health, education, environment, etc.). Subject-level detail is more limited than in specialised collections or Regions of Russia, but the Yearbook remains the central reference product that many specialised series feed into or are consistent with.

reports.title: Federal Law No. 86-FZ of 10 July 2002 “On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Foundational statute defining the status, goals, functions and powers of the Bank of Russia. Goals include protecting the ruble and ensuring its stability, developing and strengthening the banking system, ensuring stability and development of the national payment system, and developing the financial market and ensuring its stability. Covers monetary policy, banking regulation and supervision, financial-market regulation, international reserves management, organisation of cash circulation, and oversight of the national payment system. All major Bank of Russia publications and regulatory acts rest on this law.

reports.title: Federal Law No. 395-1 of 2 December 1990 “On Banks and Banking Activities”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Principal law regulating banking activities in the Russian Federation. Defines credit institutions and banks, lists banking operations, sets registration and licensing procedures, governs operations on the securities market, and establishes requirements for the stability of the banking system and protection of depositors and creditors. Operates together with Federal Law 86-FZ as the core legal framework for the banking sector.

reports.title: Federal Law No. 161-FZ of 27 June 2011 “On the National Payment System”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Law establishing the legal and organisational basis of the national payment system of the Russian Federation. Regulates provision of payment services, money transfers, electronic means of payment, activities of subjects of the national payment system, requirements for organisation and functioning of payment systems, and supervision and oversight by the Bank of Russia. Central to domestic payment infrastructure and relevant to BRICS cross-border payment cooperation discussions.

reports.title: Federal Law No. 177-FZ of 23 December 2003 “On Insurance of Deposits in Banks of the Russian Federation”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Law establishing the legal, financial and organisational basis of the compulsory deposit-insurance system for household deposits in Russian banks. Creates the Deposit Insurance Agency, regulates the Mandatory Deposit Insurance Fund, compensation payments, and relations among banks, the Agency, the Bank of Russia and executive authorities. Aims to protect depositors’ rights, build confidence in the banking system and stimulate organised savings.

reports.title: Financial Stability Review (Bank of Russia)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Semi-annual publication of the Bank of Russia assessing systemic risks, vulnerabilities of the financial system (financial institutions, market infrastructures, non-financial sector, development institutions, shadow banking), and the resilience of financial-system entities, including through stress testing. Produced under the financial-stability mandate set out in Article 3 of Federal Law 86-FZ. Complements the monthly Financial Market Risks Review.

reports.title: Financial Market Risks Review (Bank of Russia)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Monthly (except January) publication of the Bank of Russia describing vulnerabilities of the financial system, analysing potential shocks and assessing the resilience of financial organisations. Forms part of the regular monitoring of systemic risks under the financial-stability function of Federal Law 86-FZ.

reports.title: Main Macroprudential Policy Approaches (Bank of Russia report)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Report systematising the main principles of use of the Bank of Russia’s macroprudential policy instruments, taking into account experience accumulated since 2013. Released to show how the expanded set of instruments works in synergy. Supports the financial-stability mandate under Federal Law 86-FZ.

reports.title: Monetary Policy Report (Bank of Russia)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Quarterly report providing the Bank of Russia’s detailed view of current economic developments and its medium-term forecast that form the basis for key-rate decisions. Complements the annual Monetary Policy Guidelines and the Annual Report.

reports.title: Federal Budget Execution Statistics (Ministry of Finance of Russia)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Recurring official statistics on the execution of the federal budget of the Russian Federation (monthly, quarterly and annual brief information on revenues, expenditures, deficit/surplus, sources of financing). Published by the Ministry of Finance and available as downloadable tables. Form the core fiscal-sector data of the Russian Federation and appear in National Summary Data Page / SDDS fiscal tables.

reports.title: Public Debt of the Russian Federation — Volume and Structure Statistics (Ministry of Finance)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Official statistics on the volume and structure of the public debt of the Russian Federation (federal, sub-sovereign and municipal). Published by the Ministry of Finance. Tracks domestic and external debt, government securities, guarantees and related indicators. Complements federal-budget execution data and appears in fiscal-sector SDDS tables.

reports.title: Consolidated Budget of the Russian Federation Execution Statistics (Ministry of Finance / Federal Treasury)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation / Federal Treasury
reports.description: Official statistics on the execution of the consolidated budget of the Russian Federation (including state extra-budgetary funds). Monthly and annual brief information on revenues, expenditures and balances. Produced under the Ministry of Finance / Federal Treasury statistical programme and forms part of general-government finance statistics.

reports.title: Budget Execution Report and Financial Statements of the Russian Federation (Federal Treasury)
reports.publisher: Federal Treasury of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Annual and periodic reports on the execution of the consolidated budget of the Russian Federation and the budgets of state extra-budgetary funds, including balance of execution, financial-performance report and cash-flow report. Published by the Federal Treasury as the official budget-execution accounting statements.

reports.title: Banking Regulation and Supervision Framework under Federal Law 86-FZ and Federal Law 395-1 (Bank of Russia)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: The integrated regulatory and supervisory framework for credit institutions, banking groups and bank holding companies exercised by the Bank of Russia pursuant to Chapter X of Federal Law 86-FZ and Federal Law 395-1. Encompasses off-site and on-site supervision, stress testing, recovery planning for domestic systemically important banks, licence revocation, and financial-resolution measures. Documented extensively in the Bank of Russia Annual Report and supervisory publications.

reports.title: Deposit Insurance Agency (State Corporation) — Institutional Framework under Federal Law 177-FZ
reports.publisher: State Corporation “Deposit Insurance Agency”
reports.description: The Deposit Insurance Agency is the specialised state corporation created under Federal Law 177-FZ to administer the compulsory deposit-insurance system, manage the Mandatory Deposit Insurance Fund, and participate in financial-resolution measures for credit institutions. Interacts with the Bank of Russia and the Ministry of Finance in the protection of depositors and the maintenance of banking-system confidence.

reports.title: Oversight and Supervision of the National Payment System (Bank of Russia)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: The Bank of Russia’s functions of supervision and oversight over the national payment system under Federal Law 161-FZ and Chapter XII.1 of Federal Law 86-FZ. Includes review of payment-system rules, monitoring of NPS participants, disciplinary measures, and development of the digital-ruble platform. Documented in the Annual Report and related NPS publications.

reports.title: National Summary Data Page — Fiscal Sector (Ministry of Finance / SDDS)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation (with Bank of Russia and Rosstat)
reports.description: Russia’s National Summary Data Page fiscal-sector tables disseminating general-government and central-government operations, debt, and related indicators in accordance with the IMF Special Data Dissemination Standard. Compiled from Ministry of Finance, Federal Treasury and related sources.

reports.title: Monetary Aggregates (M0, M1, M2, M2X) — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Official monthly statistics on the monetary aggregates of the Russian Federation: M0 (currency in circulation outside the banking system), M1, M2 (national definition of money supply), and M2X (broad money, including foreign-currency components). Published by the Bank of Russia with annual, monthly and year-to-date growth rates and counterparts (claims on economy, net foreign assets, etc.). Core monetary-statistics series under the Bank of Russia’s monetary and financial statistics programme.

reports.title: Monetary Base (Narrow and Broad Definition) — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Official statistics on the monetary base of the Russian Federation in both narrow and broad definitions. Published as part of the Bank of Russia’s monetary statistics suite and summarised in the Annual Report and Statistical Bulletin. Closely linked to the operational target of monetary policy (keeping interbank rates close to the key rate).

reports.title: Bank of Russia Statistical Bulletin
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Monthly statistical bulletin of the Bank of Russia containing comprehensive tables on macroeconomic and monetary indicators, money supply and its structure, depository corporations survey, banking-sector quantitative characteristics, loans, deposits, capital adequacy, financial performance of credit institutions, and related series. Primary recurring statistical publication of the Bank of Russia for the financial sector.

reports.title: Quantitative Characteristics and Performance Indicators of the Banking Sector — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Recurring official statistics on the number and structure of operating credit institutions and their branches, volume of loans granted (by currency, borrower type, interest-rate ranges), outstanding amounts including overdue debt, capital adequacy, and financial performance (profit/loss) of the banking sector. Published on the Bank of Russia banking-sector statistics pages and in the Statistical Bulletin and Annual Report.

reports.title: Depository Corporations Survey — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Survey of depository corporations (including the Bank of Russia and other depository corporations) presenting net foreign assets, net claims on general government, claims on other sectors, and broad-money liabilities. Forms part of the monetary and financial statistics framework and is published in the Statistical Bulletin and Annual Report statistical tables.

reports.title: National Wealth Fund (FNB) — Volume, Movement of Funds and Management Results Statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Official statistics on the volume of the National Wealth Fund (Фонд национального благосостояния), movement of funds, liquid and illiquid assets, placement of resources (including deposits in VEB.RF and other instruments), and results of management. Published by the Ministry of Finance as recurring tables and open-data sets. The NWF is the principal sovereign wealth / fiscal-reserve fund of the Russian Federation, funded primarily from oil and gas revenues under the fiscal rules.

reports.title: National Wealth Fund Open Data Set (Ministry of Finance)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Open-data publication of the volume of the National Wealth Fund according to the reporting form approved by Ministry of Finance Order. Provides machine-readable time series of the Fund’s size. Complements the narrative and tabular statistics on the Ministry of Finance NWF pages.

reports.title: Bank of Russia Key Rate and Interest-Rate Corridor
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: The key rate is the main instrument of the Bank of Russia’s monetary-policy operational framework. The interest-rate corridor (standing deposit and lending facilities) is set relative to the key rate. Decisions and the resulting corridor are published after each Board of Directors monetary-policy meeting and are summarised in the Monetary Policy Guidelines, Monetary Policy Report and Annual Report. Operational objective is to keep overnight interbank rates (RUONIA) close to the key rate.

reports.title: Banking Sector Assets, Capital Adequacy and Financial Performance — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Recurring analysis and statistics on the total assets of credit institutions, structure of assets by group, capital adequacy ratios (N1.0 and related), net profit of the banking sector, loan-loss provisions, and related performance indicators. Published in the Annual Report, Financial Stability Review and Statistical Bulletin. Forms the core high-level picture of banking-system health used in financial-stability assessments.

reports.title: Loans Granted and Outstanding Amounts by Credit Institutions — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Detailed statistics on the volume of loans granted to resident legal entities, individual entrepreneurs and individuals (in rubles, foreign currency and precious metals), outstanding amounts including overdue debt, preferential-rate loans, and structure by interest-rate type and benchmark. Published on the Bank of Russia banking-sector statistics pages and in the Statistical Bulletin.

reports.title: Housing (Mortgage) Loan Market Statistics — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Specialised recurring statistics on the housing (mortgage) loan market of the Russian Federation, including volumes, outstanding amounts and related indicators. Published as part of the Bank of Russia banking-sector statistics suite.

reports.title: Central Bank Survey and Other Depository Corporations Survey — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Surveys of the central bank and other depository corporations forming part of the monetary and financial statistics framework. Provide the building blocks for the monetary aggregates, monetary base and depository corporations survey. Published in the Statistical Bulletin and related monetary-statistics pages.

reports.title: Digital Ruble Platform and Pilot Testing — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: The Digital Ruble Platform is the infrastructure for the central-bank digital currency of the Russian Federation. Pilot testing began in August 2023 with a limited number of banks and clients and has been progressively expanded (systemically important banks and larger client sets by end-2025). The Bank of Russia reports on the number of participating banks, clients, transfers and payments, and security assessments. Development of the digital ruble is a statutory function under Federal Law 86-FZ (organisation and ensuring the functioning of the digital ruble platform).

reports.title: Financial Accounts of the System of National Accounts of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Statistical publication presenting the financial accounts of the System of National Accounts for the Russian Federation (covering institutional sectors including non-financial corporations, financial corporations, general government, households, etc.). Compiled and published by the Bank of Russia. Provides the stock and flow picture of financial assets and liabilities across the economy and links monetary statistics to the broader national-accounts framework.

reports.title: Russian Financial Market Development Programme (medium-term)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Medium-term programme setting priorities for the development of the Russian financial market (current edition covering 2026–2028). Addresses financial-institutions’ assets relative to GDP, stock-market capitalisation, long-term savings, digitalisation of financial services, collective investment, non-credit financial institutions, and related indicators. Complements the Monetary Policy Guidelines and the financial-stability framework under Federal Law 86-FZ.

reports.title: Review of Key Indicators of Insurers — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Recurring review of key indicators of the insurance sector (premiums, contracts, payments, capital, regulatory ratios). Published by the Bank of Russia as part of its supervision of non-credit financial institutions under the expanded financial-market mandate of Federal Law 86-FZ. Summarised in the Annual Report and Financial Stability Review.

reports.title: Review of Key Indicators of Non-governmental Pension Funds — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Recurring review of key indicators of non-governmental pension funds (NPFs), including assets, capital, returns on pension reserves and pension savings, and participation in the Long-term Savings Programme (LSP). Published under the Bank of Russia’s supervision of non-credit financial institutions.

reports.title: Collective Investment Market (Unit Investment Funds and Management Companies) — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Statistics and analysis of the collective investment market, including the number of unit investment funds (UIFs) and management companies, net asset value (NAV), net inflows by type of fund (open-end, closed-end, exchange-traded), and related indicators. Published in the Annual Report and specialised reviews of the Bank of Russia.

reports.title: Digital Financial Assets (DFA) Market — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Statistics and regulatory framework for the digital financial assets market in the Russian Federation. Covers the number of information-system operators and DFA exchange operators, volume of issues and funds raised, investor access rules (including limits for non-qualified investors), and measures related to foreign digital rights and crypto-linked instruments. Reported in the Annual Report and specialised market reviews.

reports.title: Selected Indicators on the Russian Federation’s Payment System — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Recurring statistical tables on payment-card transactions, structure of funds transfers through the Bank of Russia Payment System (BRPS), Faster Payments System (SBP) volumes, and related payment-system indicators. Published in the Statistical Bulletin and summarised in the Annual Report. Operational data supporting oversight under Federal Law 161-FZ and Federal Law 86-FZ.

reports.title: Faster Payments System (SBP) — Operational Statistics and Development
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: The Faster Payments System is a key component of the national payment system enabling near-instant transfers. The Bank of Russia publishes statistics on the number and value of SBP transactions (which have grown rapidly) and reports on the expansion of services and accessibility. Forms part of the payment-system development work under Federal Law 161-FZ.

reports.title: Bank of Russia Payment System (BRPS) — Funds Transfer Statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: The systemically important Bank of Russia Payment System handles the bulk of large-value and interbank transfers. Statistics on the number and value of funds transfers (including by credit institutions and other customers) are published in the Statistical Bulletin and Annual Report. Central to the implementation of monetary and fiscal policy settlements.

reports.title: List of Financial Corporations — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Quarterly list of financial corporations published by the Bank of Russia, covering institutional units in the subsectors of the financial sector (deposit-taking corporations except the central bank, insurance corporations, pension funds, investment funds, other financial intermediaries). Supports the compilation of financial accounts and the monitoring of the non-bank financial sector.

reports.title: The Bank of Russia’s Work: Results in Brief (annual summary publication)
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Concise annual publication summarising the Bank of Russia’s main activities and results across monetary policy, financial stability, banking supervision, payment-system development (including digital ruble and SBP), financial-market development, and consumer protection. Complements the full Annual Report with a shorter, accessible overview.

reports.title: Industrial Production Index (IPI) — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Monthly official industrial production index measuring the change in the physical volume of production of a fixed set of products. Calculated for mining and quarrying, manufacturing, electricity/gas/steam supply, and water supply/waste management (OKVED-2 sections B–E). Compiled under the Official Statistical Methodology approved by Rosstat Order and disseminated according to the Federal Plan for Statistical Works. A core real-economy indicator supplied to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodology for the Formation of Official Statistical Information on the Output of Goods and Services and Indices of Physical Volume of Output by Types of Economic Activity Relating to Industrial Production (Rosstat Order No. 351 of 30 June 2026)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical methodology approved by Rosstat that defines the procedures for annual and quarterly calculations of the output of goods and services and indices of physical volume of output for industrial production activities. Implements the requirements of Federal Law 282-FZ on official statistical accounting and underpins the Industrial Production Index series.

reports.title: Producer Price Index (PPI) — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official producer price indices for industrial goods and related series. Disseminated under SDDS metadata and the Federal Plan for Statistical Works. Used as deflators in industrial production and national-accounts calculations and supplied to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication price-indices chapter.

reports.title: Foreign Trade Statistics of the Russian Federation — Federal Customs Service
reports.publisher: Federal Customs Service of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Official customs statistics on the foreign trade of the Russian Federation (exports, imports, trade balance, commodity and geographic structure). Published by the Federal Customs Service as monthly and annual summaries. Primary source for merchandise trade data that feed the balance of payments (Bank of Russia) and appear in external-sector analysis. Commodity structure is dominated by mineral products on the export side.

reports.title: Budget Code of the Russian Federation (Federal Law No. 145-FZ of 31 July 1998)
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Foundational federal law establishing the general principles of the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, the organisation and functioning of the budget system, the legal status of participants in the budget process, inter-budgetary relations, and the procedure for the preparation, approval and execution of budgets. All federal budget laws and budget-execution statistics rest on the Budget Code.

reports.title: Forecast of Socio-Economic Development of the Russian Federation (medium-term)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Development of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Medium-term forecast of socio-economic development prepared by the Ministry of Economic Development and submitted to the Government together with the draft federal budget. Provides the macroeconomic assumptions (GDP growth, inflation, etc.) that underpin the federal budget and the Monetary Policy Guidelines. Discussed at Government meetings as part of the annual budget process under the Budget Code.

reports.title: Wages Statistics — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistics on wages (average monthly nominal and real wages, wage indices). Disseminated under SDDS metadata and the Federal Plan for Statistical Works. Closely linked to the labour-force and living-standards domains and contributed to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports.title: Unemployment Statistics — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official unemployment statistics derived primarily from the Labour Force Survey and aligned with ILO concepts. Published monthly under SDDS and the Federal Plan. Forms part of the labour-market package supplied to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports.title: Housing Market Price Indices — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official price indices for the housing market. Disseminated under SDDS metadata. Complements the CPI and PPI series in the prices domain.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodology for the Calculation of Output, Intermediate Consumption and Index of Physical Volume of Agricultural Output (Rosstat)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical methodology for the calculation of agricultural output, intermediate consumption and the index of physical volume of agricultural production. Published on the Rosstat methodology pages and used in the compilation of national accounts and sectoral statistics that appear in the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports.title: Federal Law on the Federal Budget (annual)
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Annual Federal Law adopting the federal budget of the Russian Federation for the forthcoming year and the planning period. Prepared on the basis of the Budget Code and the socio-economic development forecast; submitted by the Government to the State Duma by the statutory deadline. Execution of the budget is tracked by the Ministry of Finance and Federal Treasury statistics already captured in earlier batches.

reports.title: Federal Law No. 8-FZ of 25 January 2002 “On the All-Russian Population Census”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation / President of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Primary legal instrument governing the All-Russian Population Census. Defines the census as the main source of official statistical information on population size, structure, distribution, socio-economic characteristics, national and language composition, and education. Establishes principles of privacy, frequency (not less than once every ten years), content of census forms, and rules for data use and publication of results. Amended multiple times; remains the foundational statute for VPN-2020/2021 and future censuses.

reports.title: Results of the All-Russian Population Census 2020 (VPN-2020) — Publication Volumes 1–11
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official results of the All-Russian Population Census conducted with reference date 1 October 2021 (postponed from 2020). Published in 11 thematic volumes covering population size and distribution, age-sex structure and marital status, education, citizenship, national composition and language skills, migration, livelihoods, household composition, fertility, labour force, and housing conditions. Results form the updated population base used for sample design of subsequent household surveys, demographic projections, and recalculation of per-capita indicators. Available electronically on the Rosstat VPN portal.

reports.title: Main Methodological and Organizational Provisions of the All-Russian Population Census 2020 (Rosstat Order No. 549 of 9 September 2021)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Rosstat Order approving the official methodological and organizational framework for VPN-2020. Aligns with Federal Law 8-FZ, Government Decree on organization of the 2020 census, UN Principles and Recommendations for Population and Housing Censuses, and Conference of European Statisticians recommendations. Covers definitions, enumeration procedures, questionnaire content, data processing, and dissemination rules.

reports.title: Sample Survey of Household Budgets (Выборочное обследование бюджетов домашних хозяйств — ОБДХ)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Core recurring household survey conducted quarterly across all subjects of the Russian Federation on a voluntary basis. Covers approximately 36–49 thousand private households (sample size adjusted periodically; recent plans cite ~36.3 thousand). Collects detailed data on monetary income, consumer expenditure (by COICOP-type classification), consumption of food and non-food goods, housing conditions, and living standards. Primary source of expenditure weights for the Consumer Price Index, data for the household sector of the System of National Accounts, and inputs for poverty and inequality analysis. Uses multi-stage stratified territorial sample; since the 2020s the sample frame draws on VPN-2020 materials.

reports.title: Methodological Provisions for the Formation of Aggregated Indicators of Household Income, Expenditure and Consumption on the Basis of the Sample Survey of Household Budgets (Rosstat Order No. 226 of 5 April 2017)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official methodology governing the aggregation of primary ОБДХ microdata into published indicators of household income, expenditure and consumption. Defines the unit of observation (private household), coverage (all private households excluding collective households), quarterly periodicity, sample size principles, and calculation of key aggregates used for CPI weights, SNA household accounts, and living-standards analysis. Replaces earlier 1998 aggregation methodology.

reports.title: Government Decree No. 2049 of 26 November 2021 “On Approval of the Rules for Determining Poverty Lines ... and on Amendments to the Federal Plan of Statistical Works”
reports.publisher: Government of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Establishes the post-2020 methodology for the national poverty line (граница бедности) used in official poverty statistics. From 1 January 2021 the poverty line is calculated by indexing the base poverty line (equal to the subsistence minimum for Q4 2020) by the consumer price index (chain method) relative to Q4 2020. Applies both at federal level (quarterly) and by subject of the Federation (annually). Replaces the previous direct use of the subsistence minimum as the poverty threshold for the indicator “population with monetary incomes below the poverty line”.

reports.title: Official Statistical Information on the Number and Share of the Population with Monetary Incomes below the Poverty Line (Уровень бедности)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Recurring series measuring the absolute number and percentage of the population whose average per-capita monetary income falls below the official poverty line. Calculated from the distribution of the population by size of average per-capita monetary income (derived from household surveys and macroeconomic income estimates) compared with the poverty line defined under Government Decree 2049/2021. Published quarterly and annually; data for periods after 2020 have been revised to incorporate VPN-2020 results. Used for monitoring living standards and for national-goal indicators.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodologies for Determining Summary Indicators of Wholesale and Retail Trade Statistics (Rosstat Order No. 259 of 29 May 2025)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Current official methodologies (two annexes) for the calculation of turnover of wholesale trade, turnover of retail trade, turnover per capita, physical volume indices of wholesale and retail trade, share of internet sales, and related indicators. Replaces the 2016 methodology (Order 301) and a 2023 amendment. Defines data sources (combination of full and sample surveys), treatment of unobserved activity, deflator construction (using CPI, PPI and other price indices), and algorithms for federal and regional aggregates. Forms the methodological basis for monthly and annual trade statistics that enter national accounts and short-term economic indicators.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodology for Compiling the Fuel and Energy Balance of the Russian Federation (Rosstat Order No. 229 of 4 April 2014)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Foundational methodology for the national Fuel and Energy Balance (ТЭБ). Defines the TEB as an integrated statistical instrument that links single-product energy balances into a coherent system covering extraction/production, changes in stocks, losses, imports/exports and final use of all primary and secondary energy resources. Specifies source statistical forms, conversion factors, and presentation structure. Continues to underpin subsequent energy-balance work and is referenced in later methodologies and socio-economic forecasts.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodology for Forming the Balance of Production and Consumption of Electricity (Rosstat Order No. 353 of 23 July 2025)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Current methodology for the annual Balance of Production and Consumption of Electricity. Defines resources (production by all power stations and generators, imports) and consumption (organizations by economic activity, households, network losses, and inter-system transfers). Provides explicit balancing identities at federal and subject-of-Federation levels. Relies primarily on form 23-N statistical reporting. Published data appear under the “Fuel and Energy Balances” section of official statistics.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodology for Forming Official Statistical Information on the Use of Fuel and Energy Resources (Rosstat Order No. 381 of 5 August 2025)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Methodology governing the compilation of statistics on the volume and structure of fuel and energy consumption at federal and regional levels. Explicitly stated to serve as the principal information base for compiling the Fuel and Energy Balance. Covers indicators derived from form 4-TER and related reporting, including actual expenditure of electricity and heat per unit of output for selected products.

reports.title: Regions of Russia. Socio-economic Indicators (Регионы России. Социально-экономические показатели)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Flagship annual (or near-annual) compilation presenting official statistical information on demographic, labour, income, living-standards, national-accounts (including GRP), industry, agriculture, construction, trade, transport, social and environmental indicators for every subject of the Russian Federation and for federal districts. Primary vehicle for cross-regional comparison and the main published source used in monitoring of socio-economic development of the subjects.

reports.title: Regions of Russia. Main Characteristics of the Subjects of the Russian Federation (Регионы России. Основные характеристики субъектов Российской Федерации)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Detailed statistical portrait of each republic, krai, oblast, federal city, autonomous oblast and autonomous okrug. Covers territory, population, economy and social sphere of every subject. Issued electronically; latest available edition covers 2025. Complements the broader socio-economic indicators volume with subject-by-subject depth.

reports.title: Regions of Russia. Main Socio-economic Indicators of Cities (Регионы России. Основные социально-экономические показатели городов)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Biennial compilation covering capitals of republics, centres of krais and oblasts, and cities with population over 100 000. Provides comparable socio-economic indicators for major urban centres arranged by federal district and subject. Issued electronically since 2013.

reports.title: Statistical Yearbook «Moscow» (Статистический ежегодник «Москва»)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Moscow and Moscow Oblast (Mosstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication of Mosstat on the City of Moscow. Covers population, labour market and living standards, industry, construction, trade, transport, finance, investment, science, and social sphere for the federal city. Data typically presented for a multi-year window with methodological notes. Electronic editions available on the Mosstat site.

reports.title: Moscow in Figures (Москва в цифрах) — Short Statistical Handbook
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Moscow and Moscow Oblast (Mosstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook summarising key socio-economic indicators of the City of Moscow (population, labour, incomes, prices, production, trade, construction, etc.). Complements the full Statistical Yearbook with a more compact presentation suitable for rapid reference.

reports.title: Saint Petersburg in [Year]. Statistical Yearbook (Санкт-Петербург в … году. Статистический ежегодник)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast (Petrostat)
reports.description: Principal annual statistical publication of Petrostat. Contains more than 280 tables and graphs covering labour market and living standards, social sphere, gross regional product, industry, trade, investment, science, and selected district-level indicators for the federal city of Saint Petersburg. Multi-year dynamics and comparisons with the North-Western Federal District and the Russian Federation are included.

reports.title: Saint Petersburg in Figures (Санкт-Петербург в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast (Petrostat)
reports.description: Shorter annual statistical handbook of key socio-economic indicators for Saint Petersburg (living standards, prices, education, trade, industry, construction, labour market, institutional structure). Complements the full yearbook.

reports.title: Krasnoyarsk Krai Statistical Yearbook (Красноярский краевой статистический ежегодник)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnoyarsk Krai, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tyva (Krasnoyarskstat)
reports.description: Full annual statistical yearbook for Krasnoyarsk Krai (Siberian Federal District). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry (including mining and processing characteristic of the region), agriculture, construction, trade, transport, finance, investment and social indicators. Electronic editions (RAR/ZIP) published regularly; latest available for 2025. Represents a major Siberian subject-level statistical system.

reports.title: Krasnoyarsk Krai in Figures (Красноярский край в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnoyarsk Krai, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tyva (Krasnoyarskstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Krasnoyarsk Krai summarising key socio-economic and demographic indicators. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook and is published regularly by Krasnoyarskstat.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Krasnoyarsk Krai (Социально-экономическое положение Красноярского края) — Monthly/Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnoyarsk Krai, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tyva (Krasnoyarskstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational report (monthly or short-period) presenting current data on production of goods and services, investment, prices, finance, labour market, trade, living standards and demography for Krasnoyarsk Krai. Forms the high-frequency counterpart to the annual yearbook series.

reports.title: Information for Monitoring the Socio-economic Situation of the Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Regular (monthly/quarterly) set of key socio-economic indicators by subject of the Federation compiled for Government monitoring purposes under Government Order. Covers industrial production, agriculture, construction, retail trade, paid services, investment, consumer prices, labour and income indicators. Complements the annual Regions of Russia volumes with higher-frequency data.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of the Federal Districts (Социально-экономическое положение федеральных округов)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Quarterly bulletin series (one issue per federal district) presenting a short statistical overview of the socio-economic situation of each federal district and its constituent subjects. Issued electronically; supplements the national and subject-level publications.

reports.title: Official Statistical Methodology for Calculating Gross Regional Product (VRP / Валовой региональный продукт)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official methodology for the calculation of Gross Regional Product (VRP) of the subjects of the Russian Federation in current and constant prices. Grounded in the System of National Accounts 2008. VRP is defined as the regional counterpart of GDP — the sum of value added created by resident institutional units on the economic territory of the subject. Recent orders (including Order 496 of 17 September 2025) refine the calculation for the year preceding the previous year and harmonise treatment of the financial corporations sector. Forms the conceptual and algorithmic basis for all published subject-level VRP series.

reports.title: Gross Regional Product of the Subjects of the Russian Federation (official series)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Annual official series of Gross Regional Product by subject of the Federation (in current prices, physical volume indices, per capita, and by industry/sector). Sum of subject VRPs is consistent with (but not identical to) national GDP after adjustments for financial corporations, collective services and taxes/subsidies on products. Latest published totals for 2024: absolute volume 186 545.1 billion roubles. Primary regional national-accounts output used in inter-regional comparison, fiscal federalism analysis and the Regions of Russia compilations.

reports.title: Sverdlovsk Oblast in [Years] — Statistical Collection (Свердловская область в … годах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Sverdlovsk Oblast and Kurgan Oblast (Sverdlovskstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication of Sverdlovskstat covering the socio-economic situation of Sverdlovsk Oblast (administrative centre Yekaterinburg, Urals Federal District). Multi-year dynamics on population, labour, living standards, industry, construction, trade, investment, prices and social sphere. Latest editions cover windows such as 2020–2024. Complements the national Regions of Russia volumes with deeper subject-level detail for a major industrial region.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Sverdlovsk Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Sverdlovsk Oblast and Kurgan Oblast (Sverdlovskstat)
reports.description: Recurring (monthly/periodic) report on the current socio-economic situation of Sverdlovsk Oblast. High-frequency counterpart to the annual statistical collection; covers production, investment, prices, labour, trade and living standards.

reports.title: Main Socio-economic Indicators of Municipal Formations of Sverdlovsk Oblast
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Sverdlovsk Oblast and Kurgan Oblast (Sverdlovskstat)
reports.description: Subject-level compilation and dissemination of key socio-economic indicators for the municipal districts, urban districts and municipal formations of Sverdlovsk Oblast. Draws on the national Municipal Indicators Database (БД ПМО) framework and local statistical observation. Provides the municipal tier beneath the oblast yearbook.

reports.title: Republic of Tatarstan — Statistical Yearbook / Collection (Республика Татарстан. Статистический сборник)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the Republic of Tatarstan (Tatarstanstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication of Tatarstanstat. Approximately 500 tables covering population, labour, living standards, industry, agriculture, construction, trade, investment, finance and social sphere of the Republic of Tatarstan. Latest editions (e.g. 2025) present multi-year dynamics. High-output Volga Federal District subject with strong industrial and petrochemical profile.

reports.title: Republic of Tatarstan — Short Statistical Handbook
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the Republic of Tatarstan (Tatarstanstat)
reports.description: Concise annual handbook summarising key socio-economic indicators of the Republic of Tatarstan. Complements the full statistical yearbook; issued in Russian and Tatar.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of the Republic of Tatarstan — Monthly/Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the Republic of Tatarstan (Tatarstanstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational report presenting detailed monthly and quarterly dynamics of the main socio-economic indicators of the Republic of Tatarstan by type of economic activity. High-frequency layer feeding the annual yearbook.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Rostov Oblast — Monthly Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Rostov Oblast (Rostovstat)
reports.description: Monthly comprehensive report on the state of the economy and social sphere of Rostov Oblast (Southern Federal District). Covers production, construction, trade, prices, labour, living standards and demographic indicators. Principal high-frequency publication of Rostovstat.

reports.title: Main Indicators of the System of National Accounts for Rostov Oblast
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Rostov Oblast (Rostovstat)
reports.description: Subject-level statistical collection presenting key national-accounts indicators (including VRP and related aggregates) for Rostov Oblast over multi-year windows. Links the regional statistical system directly to the national SNA/GRP framework.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Novosibirsk Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Novosibirsk Oblast (Novosibirskstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational reports and press releases on the socio-economic situation of Novosibirsk Oblast (Siberian Federal District), including industrial production, construction, retail trade, prices, labour and population. Complements the national Siberian coverage already established with Krasnoyarsk Krai.

reports.title: Gross Regional Product and Regional National Accounts Indicators of Novosibirsk Oblast
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Novosibirsk Oblast (Novosibirskstat)
