reports.description: Subject-level publication and tables of VRP, value added by industry, and related national-accounts indicators for Novosibirsk Oblast. Explicitly positioned within the regional accounts system and ranked against other Siberian subjects and the Russian Federation.

reports.title: Database of Indicators of Municipal Formations (База данных показателей муниципальных образований — БД ПМО)
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: National database and dissemination system of socio-economic indicators for municipal formations (municipal districts, urban districts, rural settlements, etc.) across all subjects of the Russian Federation. Covers territory, population, labour, incomes, housing, education, health, production and other domains. Primary source for municipal-tier statistics; territorial organs extract and publish subject-specific municipal indicator sets from it. Continuously updated; historical series available from the mid-2000s.

reports.title: Krasnodar Krai Statistical Yearbook (Краснодарский край. Статистический ежегодник)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnodar Krai and the Republic of Adygea (Krasnodarstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication for Krasnodar Krai (Southern Federal District, populous and agriculturally/industrially developed). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry, agriculture, construction, trade, prices, finance and social indicators with multi-year dynamics. Latest editions (e.g. 2024) published electronically by Krasnodarstat.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Krasnodar Krai — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnodar Krai and the Republic of Adygea (Krasnodarstat)
reports.description: Recurring (monthly/period) comprehensive report on the socio-economic situation of Krasnodar Krai, including the federal territory Sirius. High-frequency counterpart to the annual yearbook.

reports.title: Republic of Bashkortostan in Figures (Республика Башкортостан в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the Republic of Bashkortostan (Bashkortostanstat)
reports.description: Annual concise statistical handbook for the Republic of Bashkortostan (Volga Federal District, populous industrial and resource region). Multi-year presentation of key socio-economic and demographic indicators. Complements fuller collections and operational reports of Bashkortostanstat.

reports.title: Main Socio-economic Indicators of the Republic of Bashkortostan — Periodic Reports
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the Republic of Bashkortostan (Bashkortostanstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational publications of the main socio-economic indicators of the Republic of Bashkortostan (monthly/period). High-frequency layer feeding annual handbooks and national regional compilations.

reports.title: Statistical Yearbook «Moscow Oblast» (Статистический ежегодник «Московская область»)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Moscow and Moscow Oblast (Mosstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication of Mosstat specifically for Moscow Oblast (distinct from the City of Moscow). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry, construction, trade, investment and social sphere of the oblast. Multi-year dynamics; electronic editions available. Completes the Mosstat pair of federal-city + surrounding oblast coverage.

reports.title: Moscow Oblast in Figures (Московская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Moscow and Moscow Oblast (Mosstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Moscow Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook «Moscow Oblast» with a compact presentation of key indicators.

reports.title: Republic of Tyva Statistical Yearbook (Статистический ежегодник Республики Тыва)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnoyarsk Krai, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tyva (Krasnoyarskstat / Tyva coverage)
reports.description: Full annual statistical yearbook for the Republic of Tyva (Siberian Federal District). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry, agriculture, construction, trade and social indicators of a relatively sparse, lower-income Siberian republic. Provides explicit contrast with more populous and industrially developed subjects. Electronic editions published regularly.

reports.title: Republic of Tyva in Figures (Республика Тыва в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnoyarsk Krai, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tyva (Krasnoyarskstat / Tyva coverage)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for the Republic of Tyva. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook and supports comparison with other Siberian subjects.

reports.title: Socio-economic Indicators by Administrative Okrugs and Districts of the City of Moscow (within Mosstat publications)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Moscow and Moscow Oblast (Mosstat)
reports.description: Data on the 12 administrative okrugs and 132 districts (municipal formations) of the City of Moscow published within the Statistical Yearbook «Moscow», «Moscow in Figures» and related Mosstat materials. Includes territory, population, and selected socio-economic indicators at the intra-city municipal tier. Broadens the existing Moscow city nodes downward.

reports.title: Socio-economic Indicators by Districts of Saint Petersburg (within Petrostat publications)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for the City of Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast (Petrostat)
reports.description: District-level (and selected lower) indicators for Saint Petersburg published within the Statistical Yearbook and related Petrostat materials. Provides the intra-city municipal tier beneath the city yearbook nodes already established.

reports.title: Socio-economic Indicators for the City of Krasnoyarsk and Municipal Formations of Krasnoyarsk Krai
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Krasnoyarsk Krai, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tyva (Krasnoyarskstat)
reports.description: City-of-Krasnoyarsk and municipal-formation indicators published by Krasnoyarskstat (including within the Krai yearbook, «in figures» and municipal databases). Broadens the existing Krasnoyarsk Krai nodes downward to the city and municipal tier; also covers municipal data for the linked republics (Khakassia, Tyva).

reports.title: Statistical Information on Socio-economic Development of Settlements of the Russian Federation
reports.publisher: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)
reports.description: Official statistical information on socio-economic development of populated settlements (населённые пункты) formed under the Federal Plan of Statistical Works. Provides the lowest-tier settlement-level data that feed municipal and subject publications. Relevant for smaller towns and cities (including the ~50k population band) where independent titled yearbooks are rare.

dependencies.basis: The Statute on Rosstat (Government Decree 420) operationalises the functions of the Federal State Statistics Service under the legal framework established by Federal Law 282-FZ on official statistical accounting and the system of state statistics.

Rosstat SDDS metadata and the Official Statistical Methodology for CPI explicitly state that the collection of primary data and publication of official statistical information are carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 282-FZ of 29 November 2007.

National-accounts compilation and dissemination by Rosstat are governed by Federal Law 282-FZ and the Statute on Rosstat; the law requires application of official statistical methodology, including for national accounts.

The Federal Plan for Statistical Works is the Government-approved instrument that schedules the production of official statistics by subjects of official statistical accounting as required under Federal Law 282-FZ.

Rosstat supplies Russian consumer-price-index data that appear in the price-indices chapter of the annual BRICS Joint Statistical Publication; the JSP sources list Federal State Statistics Service of the Russian Federation for Russian CPI series.
Rosstat supplies Russian national-accounts / GDP data that form part of the national-accounts chapter of the annual BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Rosstat population and demographic data are contributed to the corresponding chapters of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Rosstat employment, unemployment and related labour-market data appear in the labour and living-standards sections of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

Recent Bank of Russia Annual Reports discuss BRICS financial-cooperation work, including the Contingent Reserve Arrangement context and the BRICS Cross-Border Payments Initiative, situating Russia’s external-sector and payment-system activities within the broader BRICS architecture established by the CRA Treaty and related instruments.

The Bank of Russia Annual Report contains the official analysis and presentation of the balance of payments, international investment position and external debt statistics compiled by the Bank of Russia.
International-reserves data published by the Bank of Russia are summarised and analysed in the Annual Report as part of the external-sector and monetary-policy review.
The medium-term Monetary Policy Guidelines set the inflation target and operational framework that the Annual Report reviews in its assessment of monetary-policy implementation.
The short handbook summarises key indicators from the full Samara Statistical Yearbook.
Monthly socio-economic situation reports feed the annual yearbook for Samara Oblast.
Periodic socio-economic situation reports supply high-frequency data later consolidated into the annual yearbook.
The short handbook is a condensed presentation of key indicators from the full Irkutsk Oblast Statistical Yearbook.
High-frequency socio-economic situation reports feed the annual yearbook for Irkutsk Oblast.

Both are major Siberian industrial subject yearbooks; Irkutsk and Krasnoyarsk data are routinely compared in national and federal-district compilations and share the same Siberian Federal District context.
The subject-level appendix is the official regional breakdown published together with the main collection «Industrial Production in Russia».
Chelyabinsk Oblast industrial indicators align with the national industrial production subject appendix (major metallurgical subject).
The main-indicators bulletin is a more frequent, condensed product of the same agricultural statistical system that produces the fuller Agriculture in Russia collection.
The subject-level appendix is the official regional breakdown published with the main collection «Construction in Russia».
Housing commissioning series and analytical notes are produced within the same construction statistical system and are systematically reflected in the Construction in Russia collection.
The subject-level appendix is the official regional breakdown published with the main collection «Transport in Russia».
Krasnoyarsk Krai (major industrial and resource subject) industrial indicators align with the national industrial production subject appendix.
Industrial production volumes and indices feed the calculation of value added in industry within the VRP/national accounts framework.
Agricultural production data feed the calculation of value added in agriculture within the VRP framework.
Construction activity volumes feed the calculation of value added in construction within the VRP framework.
The subject-level appendix is the official regional breakdown published together with the main collection «Healthcare in Russia» from the same statistical system.
Series on medical organisations, beds and staff are core inputs to the Healthcare in Russia collection.
Morbidity series form a principal med-demographic component of the Healthcare in Russia collection and its subject appendix.
Pharmaceutical manufacturing statistics are produced and published as part of the industrial production statistical system (ОКВЭД medicines and medical materials).
The Healthcare in Russia collection incorporates administrative and sectoral data supplied by the Ministry of Health alongside Rosstat’s own statistical observation.
Subject-level healthcare indicators ultimately rest on reporting from medical organisations that also feed municipal-level statistical systems.

Krasnodar Krai ranks among the highest subjects for collective accommodation stock; national tourism statistics and the subject yearbook share the same underlying observation system for accommodation and tourist flows.
Employment and unemployment indicators published for subjects in Regions of Russia are derived from the Labour Force Survey system.
Regional CPI and price indicators appearing in subject and national regional compilations are produced by the official consumer price statistical system.
Labour-market and staffing tables within Healthcare in Russia draw on the same labour-force statistical framework used for the general Labour Force Survey.
Moscow healthcare indicators in the city yearbook align with the national healthcare subject appendix (Moscow as a distinct subject of the Federation).

Both are flagship Rosstat products; the Yearbook presents national aggregates while Regions of Russia supplies the subject-level socio-economic matrix; they share underlying statistical systems and classifications.

The Financial Stability Review is produced under the financial-stability function explicitly set forth in Article 3 of Federal Law No. 86-FZ ‘On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)’.
The monthly Financial Market Risks Review forms part of the regular monitoring of systemic risks conducted by the Bank of Russia under its statutory financial-stability mandate in Federal Law 86-FZ.
The report systematises macroprudential instruments used by the Bank of Russia in the exercise of its financial-stability and banking-regulation powers under Federal Law 86-FZ.
The Monetary Policy Report is produced in the exercise of the Bank of Russia’s statutory function of formulating and implementing single state monetary policy under Federal Law 86-FZ.

Banking regulation and supervision are exercised by the Bank of Russia pursuant to Chapter X of Federal Law 86-FZ, which designates the Bank of Russia as the body of banking regulation and banking supervision.
Supervision of the activities of credit institutions is undertaken by the Bank of Russia in compliance with Federal Law 395-1 ‘On Banks and Banking Activities’ as well as Federal Law 86-FZ.

Oversight and supervision of the national payment system are conducted under the requirements of Federal Law No. 161-FZ ‘On the National Payment System’ and the Bank of Russia regulations adopted pursuant thereto.
Chapter XII.1 of Federal Law 86-FZ assigns the Bank of Russia responsibility for ensuring the stability and development of the national payment system.

The Deposit Insurance Agency is the specialised organisation created by Federal Law 177-FZ to perform the functions of compulsory deposit insurance, manage the Mandatory Deposit Insurance Fund, and interact with the Bank of Russia and executive authorities.

Federal-budget execution statistics published by the Ministry of Finance constitute the primary source data underlying the central-government and general-government operations tables of Russia’s National Summary Data Page fiscal sector.
Public-debt statistics published by the Ministry of Finance feed the debt tables of the National Summary Data Page fiscal sector disseminated under the IMF SDDS.
Consolidated-budget execution data form part of the general-government operations statistics disseminated via the National Summary Data Page.

The Bank of Russia Annual Report is prepared in accordance with Federal Law No. 86-FZ ‘On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)’ and reports on the exercise of all statutory functions under that law.

The Monetary Policy Guidelines are the medium-term document through which the Bank of Russia elaborates the single state monetary policy that it is required to formulate and implement under Federal Law 86-FZ.

Compilation and dissemination of the balance of payments and related external-sector statistics form part of the Bank of Russia’s functions under Federal Law 86-FZ, including the management of international reserves and the analysis supporting monetary and financial-stability policy.
Compilation and dissemination of monetary aggregates form part of the Bank of Russia’s monetary-statistics and monetary-policy functions under Federal Law 86-FZ.
Monetary-base statistics are produced under the Bank of Russia’s statutory responsibility for monetary policy and the organisation of cash circulation under Federal Law 86-FZ.

The Statistical Bulletin is the primary recurring statistical publication through which the Bank of Russia disseminates the monetary, banking and financial-sector data it is responsible for under Federal Law 86-FZ.

Quantitative characteristics and performance statistics of the banking sector are compiled and published by the Bank of Russia in the exercise of its banking-regulation and supervision functions under Federal Law 86-FZ and Federal Law 395-1.
The depository corporations survey provides the counterparts and liability structure that underlie the compilation of the broad-money aggregates (M2X) and related monetary statistics.

Movements of funds into and out of the National Wealth Fund are closely linked to oil-and-gas revenues and the financing of the federal budget deficit under the fiscal rules; NWF statistics and budget-execution statistics are published by the same ministry and are analysed together.
The open-data set provides the machine-readable time series of NWF volume that correspond to the tabular and narrative statistics published on the Ministry of Finance NWF pages.

The key rate and the interest-rate corridor are the operational instruments through which the Bank of Russia implements the monetary-policy strategy set out in the Monetary Policy Guidelines; the operational objective is to keep overnight rates close to the key rate.
Banking-sector assets, capital adequacy and profit statistics are core inputs to the systemic-risk and resilience assessments published in the Financial Stability Review.
Detailed loan-granting and outstanding-amount statistics form a major component of the broader banking-sector quantitative characteristics published by the Bank of Russia.
Housing (mortgage) loan market statistics are a specialised subset of the overall loans statistics of credit institutions.
The Central Bank Survey provides the asset and liability structure that underlies the compilation of the monetary base.
The Statistical Bulletin reproduces and expands the monetary-aggregates tables and related monetary-statistics series published by the Bank of Russia.
The Bank of Russia Annual Report contains analytical tables and charts on money supply (national definition), monetary base and their structure drawn from the monetary-aggregates statistics.

Organisation and ensuring the functioning of the digital ruble platform is an explicit function of the Bank of Russia under Federal Law 86-FZ; the pilot and platform development are reported as part of the exercise of that statutory mandate.
The digital ruble operates within the broader national payment system framework established by Federal Law 161-FZ; pilot testing and platform rules are developed consistently with NPS legislation.
Compilation of the financial accounts of the SNA is part of the Bank of Russia’s statistical responsibilities linked to its monetary and financial-stability functions under Federal Law 86-FZ.

The Financial Market Development Programme elaborates the Bank of Russia’s statutory function of developing the financial market of the Russian Federation and ensuring its stability under Federal Law 86-FZ.

Supervision and publication of key indicators of insurers form part of the Bank of Russia’s regulation, control and supervision in the sphere of financial markets under the expanded mandate of Federal Law 86-FZ.
Supervision of non-governmental pension funds and publication of their key indicators are exercised under the Bank of Russia’s financial-market regulatory powers in Federal Law 86-FZ.
Regulation and statistical monitoring of unit investment funds and management companies fall under the Bank of Russia’s financial-market supervision mandate in Federal Law 86-FZ.

The regulatory framework and statistical monitoring of the digital financial assets market are developed and published by the Bank of Russia under its financial-market development and supervision functions.
Payment-system operational statistics are compiled in the exercise of the Bank of Russia’s supervision and oversight functions under Federal Law 161-FZ on the National Payment System.
SBP transaction volumes form a major and rapidly growing component of the overall payment-system indicators published by the Bank of Russia.
BRPS funds-transfer statistics are a core table within the selected indicators on the Russian Federation’s payment system.
The quarterly List of Financial Corporations supplies the institutional-unit coverage used in the compilation of the financial accounts of the SNA for the financial-corporations sector.
The concise ‘Results in Brief’ publication summarises the same activities and statistical outcomes that are presented in greater detail in the full Bank of Russia Annual Report.
Development and pilot testing of the digital ruble platform are reported as part of the broader advancement of the national payment system and the Bank of Russia’s NPS oversight activities.

The Industrial Production Index is compiled in accordance with the Official Statistical Methodology for the formation of official statistical information on the output of goods and services and indices of physical volume of output relating to industrial production.
All official statistical information of Rosstat, including the Industrial Production Index, is formed under the legal framework of Federal Law 282-FZ on official statistical accounting.
Russian industrial-production data are among the key economic-activity indicators contributed by Rosstat to the annual BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
The Labour Force Survey is conducted and its results disseminated as official statistical information under Federal Law 282-FZ and the Federal Plan for Statistical Works.
Employment and unemployment indicators derived from the Labour Force Survey are supplied by Rosstat to the labour-market chapters of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Producer price indices are official statistical information formed under Federal Law 282-FZ and the associated methodologies.

Merchandise trade data from the Federal Customs Service are a primary input to the goods account of the balance of payments compiled by the Bank of Russia; the Bank of Russia notes adjustments to external-trade estimates in its BOP methodology.
The socio-economic development forecast is prepared and submitted as part of the budget process governed by the Budget Code; it provides the macroeconomic parameters for the draft federal budget.
The annual Federal Law on the federal budget is adopted in accordance with the procedures and principles established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
The federal budget is prepared on the basis of the socio-economic development forecast submitted by the Ministry of Economic Development together with the draft budget.
Wage statistics are closely linked to the labour-market framework; employment data from the Labour Force Survey provide the denominator context for average-wage calculations.
Official unemployment statistics are derived primarily from the Labour Force Survey conducted by Rosstat.
The agricultural-output methodology is an official statistical methodology formed under the requirements of Federal Law 282-FZ.
Industrial production indices are used as extrapolators and volume indicators in the compilation of GDP by production approach in the national accounts.
VPN-2020 was conducted and its results published pursuant to Federal Law 8-FZ, which defines the legal basis, principles and purposes of the All-Russian Population Census.
Rosstat Order 549 of 9 September 2021 explicitly implements the methodological and organizational provisions required by Federal Law 8-FZ and the Government Decree organizing the 2020 census.
Order 226 of 5 April 2017 supplies the official rules for aggregating ОБДХ microdata into the published indicators of household income, expenditure and consumption.
CPI weights are derived from consumer expenditure data collected in the Sample Survey of Household Budgets (ОБДХ); this is a standard and repeatedly documented use of the survey.
The official poverty series is calculated by comparing the distribution of average per-capita monetary incomes with the poverty line defined under Government Decree 2049 of 26 November 2021.
Poverty estimates rely on the distribution of monetary incomes derived from household survey data (including ОБДХ and related income surveys) combined with macroeconomic income aggregates.
Order 259 of 29 May 2025 is issued pursuant to Article 7 of Federal Law 282-FZ on official statistical accounting and the Rosstat statute (Government Decree 420).
The 2014 TEB methodology is an official statistical methodology adopted under the framework of Federal Law 282-FZ.
Order 353 of 23 July 2025 explicitly cites Article 7 of Federal Law 282-FZ and the Federal Plan of Statistical Works as the legal basis for the electricity balance methodology.

The 2025 methodology on the use of fuel and energy resources is stated to provide the principal information base for compiling the Fuel and Energy Balance whose framework was set by Order 229 of 2014.
The Yearbook incorporates updated population figures and structures derived from the VPN-2020 results and presents them alongside other socio-economic indicators.
The Yearbook contains sections on household incomes, expenditures and living standards that draw on the Sample Survey of Household Budgets and related income statistics.

The Regions of Russia series is an official statistical publication produced under the Federal Plan of Statistical Works and the legal framework of Federal Law 282-FZ on official statistical accounting.

Both volumes draw on the same underlying regional statistical system; the Main Characteristics volume provides a more detailed subject-by-subject presentation of indicators also summarised in the broader Socio-economic Indicators volume.
The short handbook «Moscow in Figures» is a condensed presentation of key indicators drawn from the same Mosstat data system that produces the full Statistical Yearbook «Moscow».
The short handbook is a condensed extract of key indicators from the full Petrostat Statistical Yearbook for Saint Petersburg.
Krasnoyarsk Krai yearbook data feed the corresponding subject rows of the national Regions of Russia socio-economic indicators and characteristics volumes.
The concise «Krasnoyarsk Krai in Figures» handbook summarises indicators published in fuller form in the Krasnoyarsk Krai Statistical Yearbook.
Federal-district bulletins aggregate and present subject-level data that also appear in the national Regions of Russia volumes, organised by federal district.
Population and demographic structures in the Moscow yearbook incorporate results and revisions based on the All-Russian Population Census 2020 (VPN-2020).

The published VRP series by subject are calculated according to the official statistical methodology for Gross Regional Product (including the 2025 refinements on financial corporations and constant-price calculation).
VRP is the regional counterpart of GDP within the System of National Accounts; the national accounts framework and classifications underpin the regional calculation.
The Regions of Russia socio-economic indicators volume systematically presents VRP and related regional accounts indicators for every subject.
Subject-level municipal indicator publications are extracted and presented from the national Municipal Indicators Database (БД ПМО) framework.
Municipal indicators form the lowest tier that aggregates into the oblast-level socio-economic picture published in the Sverdlovsk statistical collection.
Monthly/periodic socio-economic reports provide the high-frequency data later consolidated into the annual yearbook.
Novosibirsk Oblast VRP and regional accounts tables are produced under the national official methodology for Gross Regional Product.
Subject-level VRP figures for Novosibirsk Oblast form part of the national official VRP series by subject and are ranked against other Siberian subjects within that series.
The Municipal Indicators Database is an official statistical information system maintained under the Federal Law on official statistical accounting and the Federal Plan of Statistical Works.
Bashkortostan indicators in national regional compilations are consistent with the annual «in figures» handbook and operational reports of Bashkortostanstat.
Periodic main socio-economic indicator reports feed the annual handbook for the Republic of Bashkortostan.
Moscow Oblast data in national Regions of Russia volumes are consistent with the Mosstat Statistical Yearbook «Moscow Oblast».
The short handbook is a condensed presentation of key indicators from the full Moscow Oblast Statistical Yearbook.

Both the City of Moscow and Moscow Oblast yearbooks are produced by the same territorial body (Mosstat) under a coordinated regional statistical programme; they share methodological and data-collection infrastructure while remaining distinct subjects.
The concise «Tyva in figures» handbook summarises indicators published in fuller form in the Republic of Tyva Statistical Yearbook.

Both yearbooks are produced under the same territorial body (Krasnoyarskstat covering Krasnoyarsk Krai, Khakassia and Tyva); they share institutional and methodological infrastructure while remaining distinct subject-level publications, enabling direct contrast between a major industrial krai and a sparser republic.
Administrative-okrug and district indicators are published as part of, or drawn from the same data system as, the Statistical Yearbook «Moscow» and related Mosstat materials.
Intra-city municipal (district/okrug) indicators align with the national Municipal Indicators Database framework used across subjects.
District-level indicators for Saint Petersburg are published within or derived from the same Petrostat system that produces the city Statistical Yearbook.
City-of-Krasnoyarsk and municipal-formation indicators form the lower tier that aggregates into the Krasnoyarsk Krai Statistical Yearbook and related publications.
Municipal indicators for Krasnoyarsk Krai (and the linked republics) are maintained and disseminated within the national БД ПМО framework.
